profile.name: Xspress3 多通道 X 射线探测器
profile.description: Xspress3 是用于同步辐射和实验室 X 射线测量的多通道探测系统/多道分析器控制设备。该驱动证据显示其支持连续采集、步进扫描、ROI 保存、数组数据采集、设定驻留时间、布防/启动/停止采集，以及文件保存和标定信息管理，适合 X 射线荧光或能谱扫描实验中的高速数据采集。
profile.description_en: Xspress3 is a multi-channel detector and multi-channel analyzer control system for synchrotron and laboratory X-ray measurements. The driver evidence shows support for continuous acquisition, step-scan operation, ROI saving, array-data acquisition, dwell-time setting, arm/start/stop control, and file/calibration handling, making it suitable for high-speed X-ray fluorescence or spectroscopic scanning experiments.
